messages.content: You are BrightCart's support assistant.
[Customer: Asha] I was charged twice for order #88231.
Hi Asha, you're right, order #88231 was charged twice, and I've refunded the second payment. It will reach your card in 5 to 7 working days. Your reference is BC-55120.
You are BrightCart's support assistant.
[Customer: Ravi] Where is my order? It was supposed to come on Monday.
Hi Ravi, I'm sorry your order is late. It's at the Pune hub and due tomorrow. I've added a Rs 100 voucher to your account for the wait. Your reference is BC-55121.
You are BrightCart's support assistant.
[Customer: Meera] I want to return the laptop I bought 20 days ago.

Hi Meera, laptops can be returned within 10 days of delivery, and yours arrived 20 days ago, so I can't start a return. If it has a fault, the brand warranty covers it and I can book a service centre visit for you. Your reference is BC-55122.
You are BrightCart's support assistant.
[Customer: Imran] How do I change my email address?
Hi Imran, you can change it under Account > Profile > Email. We'll send a code to both your old and new address to confirm. Your reference is BC-55123.
You are BrightCart's support assistant.
[Customer: Kavya] The app keeps crashing when I open my cart.
Hi Kavya, this is a known issue in app version 9.4.0. Please update to 9.4.2 from the Play Store and it should be fixed. If it still crashes, reply here with a screenshot. Your reference is BC-55124.
You are BrightCart's support assistant.
[Customer: Joseph] My parcel says delivered but I don't have it.

Hi Joseph, I'm sorry about this. Please check with neighbours and building security first. If it hasn't turned up in 24 hours, reply here and I'll open an investigation with the courier, who has 48 hours to respond. Your reference is BC-55125.
You are BrightCart's support assistant.
[Customer: Lakshmi] Can I cancel my order? I ordered the wrong size.

Hi Lakshmi, yes. Your order hasn't shipped yet, so you can cancel it for free under My Orders, then order the right size. Your coupon comes back to your account within 24 hours. Your reference is BC-55126.
You are BrightCart's support assistant.
[Customer: Arjun] Someone placed an order from my account that I didn't make!

Hi Arjun, I've locked your account to keep it safe and cancelled the order you didn't place. Please call your bank to block the card that was used. Our Trust team will contact you within 24 hours. Your reference is BC-55127.
You are BrightCart's support assistant.
[Customer: Neha] Is Plus worth it? How much does it cost?

Hi Neha, BrightCart Plus costs Rs 1,499 a year or Rs 179 a month. You get free express delivery, early access to sales and 5% back on electronics. You can cancel at any time. Your reference is BC-55128.
You are BrightCart's support assistant.
[Customer: Farhan] Do you deliver to Shillong? How long does it take?
Hi Farhan, yes, we deliver to Shillong. Standard delivery takes 5 to 8 days and is free on orders above Rs 499. Your reference is BC-55129.
You are BrightCart's support assistant.
[Customer: Divya] My fridge arrived with a big dent on the door.

Hi Divya, I'm sorry it arrived damaged. Our delivery partner's technician will inspect it within 3 working days, and if it was damaged in transit we'll replace it. Please keep the photos you took. Your reference is BC-55130.
You are BrightCart's support assistant.
[Customer: Suresh] I returned a shirt 5 days ago, where is my refund?
Hi Suresh, your return passed the check yesterday, so the refund has started. It will reach your UPI account in 1 to 3 working days. Your reference is BC-55131.
